item.title: Competitions :: RE: Competitions 2027 - 30th Anniversary!
item.description:
Author: Maxim
Posted: Fri Oct 30, 2026 1:54 am (GMT 0)

I think it is impossible to define a percentage scale that people can agree on. Some people are easily triggered by AI cover art, for example, even if the rest is created traditionally. That seems like it’s <10% to me. On the other hand, if 10% of the code was “vibed” that seems like a lot to me. And that’s still assuming I can make an accurate measure of that percentage.

By making the boundary vague I hope that means people will err on the side of caution. I’m hoping the “AI disclosure” requirement will ensure people give a clear picture of how much it was used and that can help provide some examples for us to set clearer boundaries in future.

One thing I’d like to rule out - at least for the next competition - is an AI-positive category.
